study_title: Gemini API Direct YouTube URL Bias-Correction Validation (N=50: fit=25, validation=25)

selection_method.algorithm: Deterministic stratified sampling with Mulberry32 PRNG seeded from SHA-256(seed_string); TiDB read-only ORDER BY id ASC; 0 direct YouTube network calls
selection_method.split_method: Matched-pair stratified random assignment (pairs formed after sorting by band, 360-900s flag, route_raw, duration_bin, calibrated_score, video_id; each pair randomly assigned 1 to fit and 1 to validation)
selection_method.pool_filter: calibratedScore IS NOT NULL AND platform='youtube' AND id NOT IN prev_10 AND duration_sec <= 900
selection_method.pool_constraints_note: In the eligible TiDB pool (n=372), only 5 videos have calibratedScore < 63 (vs. guideline target of 12). All 5 eligible <63 videos are included (split 3 fit / 2 validation or 2 fit / 3 validation), and the remaining 7 slots are allocated to 63-82 (enriched near the 63 boundary) and >=83 so that both boundary regions (near 63: 12 videos >= 8 target; near 83: >=14 videos >= 12 target) and all 4 duration bins (360-900s: exact 6 videos, 3 fit / 3 validation) are strongly represented.

execution_protocol.ensemble_rule: 2 independent calls per video; if |r1 - r2| >= 5, run 3rd independent call and take median of 3; otherwise take mean of 2
stop_conditions: timestamped observations clearly inconsistent with actual video / SQLite scenes
execution_protocol.replacement_policy: If Gemini API fails to process/read a specific video URL (e.g. private/unavailable on Google side without triggering global 402/403/429 stop), replace from reserve_8 matching band/duration/route as closely as possible and report the substitution.

method_B_linear_ols.name: (B) 1次式線形補正 (OLS)
method_B_linear_ols.fit_estimation: Minimize sum((calibrated_score - (a + b * api_score))^2) over fit (n=25)

pass_fail_criteria_on_validation_25.selection_rule: Among methods (A) and (B) (and checking uncorrected for reference) that satisfy all 3 pass criteria on validation (n=25), recommend the one with the lowest validation MAE. If none satisfies all 3 criteria, declare FAIL (不合格).
